title: sry no pics were allowed inside #cabaret #cabaretrevival #cabaretkitk...
transcript: If you're rich and you like to drink, you'll love the Cabaret revival that's currently on Broadway. The whole thing is meant to be an immersive experience with pre-show performances and multiple places to buy alcohol. Now, I've seen plenty of Cabarets before so I was well aware of how good the material is, but I was really curious about this production since it's gotten so much hype, especially around Eddie Redmayne and Gayle Rankin who play the Emcee and Sally. We ended up seeing Gabi Campo's debut performance as Sally and she was fantastic — the entire cast is great so you're in good hands regardless of who's on. I thought the production was very strong but nothing that groundbreaking or surprising. The costuming was striking and there are some cool directorial choices but it's not really as out there as I expected based on the marketing of the show — the storytelling is at the forefront and the material speaks for itself. Despite the rather small stage and gestural blocking, the cast still delivers emotionally grounded performances. Unfortunately, tickets are very expensive and I couldn't help but feel like $30 of my ticket price went toward the interior design of the theater and the shot of schnapps they gave me on the way in. As much as we enjoyed the show, when I factor in the price point, I might have to argue that it's a little overhyped — but again I was familiar with the show so perhaps I was unfairly expecting them to completely reinvent the wheel. Paul had never seen any Cabaret before and he was really impressed. I'd say this is a great production but I think you'll have to decide for yourself if the price is right. With that, another Playbill for my collection.
reasoning: The reviewer enjoyed the show and calls it 'a great production' with fantastic performances, but expresses reservations about the high price point and feels it's 'a little overhyped.' This represents a positive recommendation with notable caveats.
keyQuote: I'd say this is a great production but I think you'll have to decide for yourself if the price is right.
